title: Simulating Misinformation Propagation in Social Networks using Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religious Leader (Conservative Religious Leader)' as one of its primary persona agents and explicitly evaluates how religious identity and faith-based reasoning influence the propagation of misinformation. Furthermore, one of the ten news domains studied ('politics-1') specifically focuses on the role of religion in elections and Christian nationalism, making faith a core component of the study's experimental design and analysis.
